name: milton-auth-mail-failed
description: milton-auth-mail delivery passes that finished at least one send as failed: a non-429 4xx from Resend, a missed delivery deadline or an undecryptable message. Counts passes, from the job's JSON line {"message":"auth_mail_pass","claimed":…,"sent":…,"retry":…,"failed":…,"throttled":…}. Read by milton-auth-mail.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="milton-auth-mail" AND jsonPayload.message="auth_mail_pass" AND jsonPayload.failed>0
